mapper.sql: (SELECT a.dept_id,a.keeper_user_id owner_id,a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date, a.asset_status,a.purchase_price FROM ca_asset a WHERE a.asset_status!='3') x
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) assetCount,COALESCE(SUM(x.purchase_price),0) registeredValue, COALESCE(SUM(x.asset_status='1'),0) borrowedCount, COALESCE(SUM(x.asset_status='2'),0) repairingCount FROM WHERE 1=1

SELECT x.category_id id,COALESCE(c.category_name,'未找到类别') name,COUNT(*) count, COALESCE(SUM(x.purchase_price),0) value FROM LEFT JOIN ca_category c ON c.category_id=x.category_id WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY x.category_id,c.category_name ORDER BY count DESC,id

SELECT x.dept_id id,COALESCE(d.dept_name,'未找到部门') name,COUNT(*) count, COALESCE(SUM(x.purchase_price),0) value FROM LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=x.dept_id WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY x.dept_id,d.dept_name ORDER BY count DESC,id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(x.kind='BORROW'),0) borrowAudit, COALESCE(SUM(x.kind='PICKUP'),0) pickupHandover, COALESCE(SUM(x.kind='RETURN'),0) returnHandover, COALESCE(SUM(x.kind='ACCEPT'),0) repairAcceptance, COALESCE(SUM(x.kind='VERIFY'),0) repairVerification, COALESCE(SUM(x.kind='INVENTORY'),0) inventoryReview, COALESCE(SUM(x.kind='SCRAP'),0) scrapAudit FROM ( SELECT b.asset_dept_id dept_id,b.applicant_user_id owner_id,'BORROW' kind, a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date,'campus:borrow:audit' permission FROM ca_borrow b JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=b.asset_id WHERE b.status='0' UNION ALL SELECT b.asset_dept_id,b.applicant_user_id,CASE WHEN h.handover_type='1' THEN 'PICKUP' ELSE 'RETURN' END, a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date,'campus:handover:confirm' FROM ca_handover h JOIN ca_borrow b ON b.borrow_id=h.borrow_id JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=b.asset_id WHERE h.status='0' UNION ALL SELECT r.asset_dept_id,r.reporter_user_id,CASE WHEN r.status='0' THEN 'ACCEPT' ELSE 'VERIFY' END, a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date, CASE WHEN r.status='0' THEN 'campus:repairs:assign' ELSE 'campus:repairVerify:verify' END FROM ca_repair r JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=r.asset_id WHERE r.status IN ('0','3') UNION ALL SELECT t.dept_id,t.publisher_user_id,'INVENTORY',NULL,NULL,NULL,'campus:inventoryReview:review' FROM ca_inventory_task t WHERE t.status='2' UNION ALL SELECT s.asset_dept_id,s.applicant_user_id,'SCRAP',a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date, CASE WHEN s.status='0' THEN 'campus:scrapAudit:firstAudit' ELSE 'campus:scrapAudit:finalAudit' END FROM ca_scrap s JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=s.asset_id WHERE s.status IN ('0','1') AND s.applicant_user_id != #{pendingUserId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ca_scrap_audit sa WHERE sa.scrap_id=s.scrap_id AND sa.auditor_user_id=#{pendingUserId}) ) x WHERE 1=1 AND (x.kind='INVENTORY' OR (1=1 ))
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user actor JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=actor.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id=rm.menu_id WHERE actor.user_id=#{pendingUserId} AND actor.status='0' AND actor.del_flag='0' AND r.status='0' AND r.del_flag='0' AND m.status='0' AND m.perms=x.permission AND (r.data_scope='1' OR (r.data_scope='2' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_dept rd WHERE rd.role_id=r.role_id AND rd.dept_id=x.dept_id)) OR (r.data_scope='3' AND x.dept_id=actor.dept_id) OR (r.data_scope='4' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept sd WHERE sd.dept_id=x.dept_id AND sd.del_flag='0' AND (sd.dept_id=actor.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(actor.dept_id,sd.ancestors)))) OR (r.data_scope='5' AND x.owner_id=actor.user_id)) )
mapper.sql: SELECT 'ASSET' kind,a.dept_id,a.keeper_user_id owner_id,a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date, a.registered_time event_time,a.purchase_price amount,0 difference FROM ca_asset a UNION ALL SELECT 'BORROW',b.asset_dept_id,b.applicant_user_id,a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date, b.actual_pickup_time,0,0 FROM ca_borrow b JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=b.asset_id WHERE b.actual_pickup_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'REPAIR',r.asset_dept_id,r.reporter_user_id,a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date, r.accept_time,0,0 FROM ca_repair r JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=r.asset_id WHERE r.accept_time IS NOT NULL AND r.status IN ('1','2','3','4') UNION ALL SELECT 'COST',r.asset_dept_id,r.reporter_user_id,a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date, r.verify_time,COALESCE(r.repair_cost,0),0 FROM ca_repair r JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=r.asset_id WHERE r.status='4' AND r.verify_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'INVENTORY',t.dept_id,i.assigned_user_id,a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date, i.checked_time,0,CASE WHEN i.missing_flag='1' OR i.observed_condition IN ('1','2') OR (JSON_EXTRACT(i.base_snapshot,'$.location_id') IS NOT NULL AND i.observed_location_id != CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.base_snapshot,'$.location_id')) AS UNSIGNED)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ca_inventory_item i JOIN ca_inventory_task t ON t.task_id=i.task_id JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=i.asset_id WHERE i.checked_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'SCRAP',s.asset_dept_id,s.applicant_user_id,a.category_id,a.location_id,a.purchase_date, s.completed_time,0,0 FROM ca_scrap s JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=s.asset_id WHERE s.status='3' AND s.completed_time IS NOT NULL
